thumbnail_brief: One sperm whale's huge square, scarred head rising out of black water and filling about two-thirds of the frame, with tiny red-capped Doug in scuba gear and a dive light in front of it, so the picture shows how far down and how alone he is while the title explains why each metre is worse; text at most 3 words such as '2 KM DOWN' (never an exact record depth), and never DEADLIER, DEEPER, WHALE, SPERM or DOUG.
description:
The sperm whale has the biggest brain on Earth, the loudest click of any animal, and a head that has sunk whaling ships. In this sperm whale deep dive, Doug follows one hunting dive from the surface, through the dark where it fights giant squid, to more than two kilometres down, where it finds everything by sound.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
